page_title: GIR 3-0 GET | Girona v Getafe 20/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+7' Santiago Gonzalez Garcia (Getafe) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
90+3' The referee is firm and issues Domingos Duarte (Getafe) a deserved yellow card.
90+2' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) blows a big chance from close range. World class save by the goalkeeper.
90+1' We are about to witness a substitution. Selvi Clua Oya (Girona) is replacing Yangel Herrera.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
90' Michel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Bernardo (Girona) replacing Arnau Martinez.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Gorka Rivera (Getafe) comes onto the pitch so that Damian Suarez can be given a rest.
88' Choco Lozano (Getafe) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
87' Damian Suarez (Getafe) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
87' Damian Suarez (Getafe) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
86' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
85' Getafe will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
84' Substitution. Ivan Martin did his best and is replaced by Pablo Torre (Girona).
81' A player from Girona commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
81' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Girona.
80' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Yangel Herrera (Girona) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
77' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
74' Djene (Getafe) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jorge Figueroa Vazquez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Valery (Girona) comes onto the pitch for Savio.
72' The attendance for today's match is 11784.
71' Michel has decided to make a change. Artem Dovbyk (Girona) replaces Cristhian Stuani.
66' That will be all from Carles Alena who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Santiago Gonzalez Garcia (Getafe).
65' 3 - 0 Goal! The rebound fell to Cristhian Stuani (Girona) and he fired home from close range. The score is 3:0.
62' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez shows a yellow card to Ivan Martin (Girona), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
60' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
59' Here is a change. Borja Mayoral is going off and Jose Bordalas Jimenez gives the last tactical orders to Choco Lozano (Getafe).
59' That's the end of the game for Stefan Mitrovic, who is replaced by Portu (Getafe).
59' Arnau Martinez (Girona) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
55' 2 - 0 Cristhian Stuani (Girona) latches on to a fine cross and slams the ball inside the right post. Beautiful goal.
51' A pass travels right across the box to Yangel Herrera (Girona) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper in the middle of the goal, but David Soria denies him with a decent save.
50' It's like he was asking for a caution. Djene (Getafe) receives a yellow card.
49' Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) quickly picks up the rebound and drills the ball towards the left side of the goal. The opponent's goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save to deny him.
47' Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
46' Referee Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+7' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' The ball is cleared after Damian Suarez (Getafe) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
45+3' That's a clear yellow card. Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona) goes into the book.
45+2' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it well wide of the right post.
45+1' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Getafe.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
45' One of the Getafe players was holding his opponent and the referee doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
41' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar.
39' Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) was too forceful with his tackle and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
37' Carles Alena (Getafe) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
35' Djene (Getafe) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
33' The referee blows for a cooling break.
32' A corner kick by Girona is thwarted by the well prepared David Soria (Getafe).
31' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Girona comes to nothing.
31' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Girona, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Girona have been awarded a corner kick.
30' Referee Jorge Figueroa Vazquez has finally had enough of Jose Bordalas Jimenez and brandishes a yellow card at him!
30' Girona earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
29' Stefan Mitrovic (Getafe) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Jorge Figueroa Vazquez didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
28' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Borja Mayoral (Getafe) was quite harsh and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
27' Savio (Girona) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
25' A pass into the penalty area from Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) is intercepted by the defence.
21' Getafe take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
21' Damian Suarez (Getafe) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
20' Getafe are awarded a mid-range free kick.

15' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Jorge Figueroa Vazquez signals that the goal stands! The Girona players celebrate. Goal! Savio swings the ball deep into the box and finds Yangel Herrera (Girona) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the top right corner. 1:0.
14' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Jorge Figueroa Vazquez wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
12' Girona have a goal ruled out for offside!
10' Daley Blind (Girona) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
8' Good clearance! Aleix Garcia (Girona) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
7' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez shows the yellow card to Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) for a heavy challenge.
5' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Girona was in an offside position.
3' Getafe have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
2' Damian Suarez (Getafe) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The referee blows his whistle, Getafe are awarded a corner kick.
2' Good clearance! Cristhian Stuani (Girona) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.
1' The match has just started.
Getafe will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Jorge Figueroa Vazquez.
